title: Orunmila quarantine log header, schema version 1
description: The first line of a session's quarantine log (`quarantine.jsonl`), where its hash chain starts. The quarantine log keeps every input that reached intake for this session and was not a valid mark, with its reasons, so nothing sent is ever dropped. Every session folder has one, even when nothing was quarantined. Quarantined records follow (quarantine.schema.json).
$comment: brief v4 lines 340-341 (a malformed mark lands in the quarantine log, nothing dropped; test 28) name no fields: every field name here is the agent's choice. Written by src/opon/ledger/session-log.js when the session log is made. Unknown fields are allowed, as in the other v1 formats (LD17).

record.description: Marks this line as the quarantine log's header, so a reader tells it from a quarantined record without guessing.

session_id.description: The session whose inputs this log keeps: the same id as the raw log's session header.

seq.description: The header is the log's first record; quarantined records follow from seq 1.

prev_hash.description: The hash chain starts from the header, so it has no previous hash.

hash.description: The header's own hash; the first quarantined record's prev_hash.
